text: ok. zoom is backwards, and rotate camera should be from the mouse while panning wasd is good also what is the junk in the area? [Image #5]
resolution: Fixed the camera feel per the screenshot feedback: (1) flipped the scroll-zoom direction (was inverted); (2) mouse DRAG now rotates the view — refactored isoStage to a continuous yaw so a drag spins the camera freely while the ⟲⟳ buttons / Q·E snap to the 45-degree iso detents; WASD keeps doing the panning, and place/select now fire on click-up so a rotate-drag never drops a piece. (3) Added an on-screen '<N> pieces · <M> props' readout to answer 'what is the junk': it's the map's REAL placed build-pieces + world props (the same content F2 and the game render via the shared PlacedPieceMeshes/WorldStatics), not an artifact — the clusters floating in the blue are pieces/props sitting outside the single painted terrain chunk, so no ground draws under them. Bundles clean (esbuild exit 0). Sign of the new drag-rotate may want tuning.
